dedupe_keys.name: kemantapan jalan nasional national road condition by province indonesia

description: Kemantapan Jalan Nasional is a dataset from Indonesia's Ministry of Public Works (Kementerian Pekerjaan Umum), republished on the Satu Data Indonesia portal, on the stability (condition) of national roads. A road is 'mantap' when it is in good or fair condition and 'tidak mantap' when lightly or heavily damaged. Coverage: all provinces, with yearly resources from 2013 to 2023 and semester files for some years. Variables are the province code (BPS codes to 2022, Ministry of Home Affairs codes from 2023), province name, total national road length in km, and the length and share of roads in mantap and tidak mantap condition. Format and access: tabular resources per year with JSON, DCAT JSON-LD and RDF metadata downloads; the source page on Open Data PU returned 403 from the cloud. Licence and cost: free; no licence was found on the page. Caveats: the portal notes the data are still being aligned with Satu Data principles; values are provincial aggregates, not segments. The series supports condition-based fragility assumptions and maintenance backlog scenarios in national road models. It relates to GRIP4 in the catalogue.
